title: VULTURES 1
description: The album cover for VULTURES 1 features Kanye West on the left and his wife Bianca Censori on the right. The couple presents itself, poised within a space adorned in subtle hues of gray. Kanye is entirely clad in black attire, including a black hockey mask, as he faces the viewer. Bianca Censori, partially nude, turns away from the observer, attired in long black stockings, black shoes and a very thin, transparent cloth around her waist. Kanye West & Ty Dolla $ign's collaborative album was released on February 10, 2024; the 20th anniversary of the release of his debut album The College Dropout. This is the only cover in Ye's discography featuring Ye's actual body besides The College Dropout. The cover art was photographed by visual director Aus Taylor, who was at first surprised by its usage over the Burzum-like one: "ye dawg thank you so much for trusting me blindly"
